question_text: Was Rockstar hacked in the GTA 6 Xbox build leak?
answer_text: Not established. Take-Two's Nov 24 takedown notice calls the files stolen game files from an Xbox build, but neither it nor Rockstar has said how they were taken or that its systems were breached.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A Rockstar or Take-Two statement on the build or a breach, a court filing, or law enforcement naming how the build was taken.

answer_text: Take-Two treats them as its own: its Nov 24 takedown notice calls them stolen game files from an Xbox Series build of GTA VI. Neither company has said whether every file is genuine.
label: Reported
what_would_settle_it: Rockstar or Take-Two confirming the files, or a second independent examination reported by press.

question_text: Did the leaker really post the executable on Nov 23?
answer_text: Reported. Twelve outlets say the leaker posted the executable on Nov 23, relaying its own posts. One outside researcher's analysis, relayed by one outlet, says it looks like a real Xbox build; Rockstar and Take-Two have not commented.
label: Reported
what_would_settle_it: A second outlet reporting the drop, or Rockstar or Take-Two taking it down and saying so.

question_text: How did the leaker get the build, and who is behind it?
what_would_settle_it: A company or law enforcement statement, or a court filing naming a method or a person.
